structure.opening_style: context-setting followed by a problem/opportunity statement
structure.section_organization: logical progression with clear, descriptive headings
structure.code_integration: generous use of code snippets and SQL queries to demonstrate practical application
structure.conclusion_style: summary of benefits often coupled with a call to action or next steps

communication.value_proposition: Combining the best of data warehouses and data lakes (Lakehouse) to drive AI and analytics at scale with lower cost and open standards.
credibility_markers: References to specific customer success stories (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy)
Mention of benchmarks and performance metrics (e.g., '20x faster')
communication.technical_depth: Deep but accessible; assumes a technical audience (data engineers/scientists) but explains the 'why' clearly.
